title: CodeLearn Learning Analysis
description: Learning explanations produced by a coding agent for the change units exported by CodeLearn.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot_id copied verbatim from the CodeLearn export.

repository.description: Optional echo of the exported repository information.

generator.description: Free-form name of the agent that produced this analysis.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the analysis was produced.

steps.description: Learning steps in the order they should be presented.

change_id.description: A change id from the CodeLearn export. Never invent one.

what.description: What changed, in terms of the implementation. Markdown.

how.description: How the changed code behaves. Markdown.

why.description: Why the code is implemented this way. Omit when the code gives no evidence. Markdown.
